subject: Linguistics
title: Linguistic Landscaping
description: A short lesson to help you apply Linguistic Landscaping.

hook.text: Walk through any city and the signs tell you which languages have power and visibility there.

buildup.text: Linguistic landscaping studies the languages displayed on signs, billboards, and notices.

discovery.text: Official signs (government) vs private signs (shops) reveal different language hierarchies.

twist.text: Graffiti in minority languages is a form of resistance—claiming space the official signs deny.

climax.text: The linguistic landscape makes invisible power relations visible on every street.

punchline.text: Who gets a sign tells you who has a voice.

quiz.question: What does linguistic landscaping study?
options: Languages visible on public signs and notices
